title: Review pages now show whether your answers are saved

steps.path: A picture review page, full-size window
steps.headline: "Saved ✓" now sits in the header of every review page.
steps.changed: Every click is saved to the file next to the page, and the header says so. If a save fails, the label turns red and reads "NOT saved — retrying" until it lands.
steps.notice: If a page ever loses its server or was left open across a restart, nothing you answered is lost: it keeps retrying, and it merges with what is already saved instead of replacing it.
steps.risk: The red "NOT saved" label is not pictured here: it only appears when a save fails. It is tested automatically.

steps.path: A picture review page, smaller window
steps.headline: In a smaller window the step counter hides, but the save label stays.
steps.changed: The step counter already hides at this width to make room; the save label never does, because a failed save is the one thing you must not miss.
steps.notice: If a page ever loses its server or was left open across a restart, nothing you answered is lost: it keeps retrying, and it merges with what is already saved instead of replacing it.
steps.risk: The red "NOT saved" label is not pictured here: it only appears when a save fails. It is tested automatically.

steps.headline: Question pages show the same save label.
steps.changed: Same label, same behaviour: saved as you answer, red and retrying if the save fails.
